full_judgment: 17. In a case reported in 12 CWN 326, it has been held by the Privy Council that the plaintiffs are entitled to deduction of the period between the 20th April, 1903, where in the previous suit he obtained a decree in their favour and the 22nd February, 1904, the date of the reversal of that decree by the appellate court, their right of action having been in suspension.
